result.description: Fictional high-capacity internal storage module for archival workstation use, featuring PCIe 4.0 x4 connectivity, NVMe interface, and a 6TB solid-state design with sustained sequential read speeds up to 7000 MB/s and write speeds up to 6200 MB/s. Intended for media ingest, large project caches, and bulk local scratch storage in tower systems with M.2 2280 support.
result.title: Orchid Atlas 6TB PCIe 4.0 NVMe Capture Module
